title: A fee bump whose inner transaction fails at apply with txBAD_MIN_SEQ_AGE_OR_GAP
pattern: The inner transaction was valid when queued; a classic transaction earlier in the same ledger changed its source, and core re-checks the source at apply (TransactionFrame::commonValid, processSignatures): minSeqLedgerGap 1, and the inner source's seqLedger moved to this ledger. The outer result is txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED with txBAD_MIN_SEQ_AGE_OR_GAP inside; the fee source pays. Readers that expect inner results to carry only operation failures, or treat a queued transaction as valid, get it wrong.

hazards.placement: InnerTransactionResult.txBAD_MIN_SEQ_AGE_OR_GAP at apply: minSeqLedgerGap 1, and the inner source's seqLedger moved to this ledger

facts.says: The inner transaction fails with txBAD_MIN_SEQ_AGE_OR_GAP.
The classic transaction that caused it is in the same ledger.
